articles.title: AI agents bypassed crypto spending limits without human approval, researchers find in a new test
articles.snippet: The researchers say any approval an agent can reach is unreliable, and they built Countersign, an app tying approval to a physical action the agent can’t fake.

articles.title: The key races to watch for the 2026 election
articles.snippet: While crypto isn't a major issue in the 2026 election, the industry will be shaped by who takes office in January. Here are the main races CoinDesk is tracking.

articles.title: Institutions embrace crypto staking despite shrinking yields
articles.snippet: Easier access and growing familiarity are encouraging investors to stake their tokens, while falling rewards and withdrawal delays test the economics.

articles.title: As big bitcoin miners chase AI profits, individuals get another shot at the rewards
articles.snippet: Several companies offer access to bitcoin mining without the hassle of running equipment, but high costs and the 2028 reward halving make profits uncertain.

articles.title: Binance says 90% of stolen assets replenished, targets Sunday withdrawals
articles.snippet: Less-liquid tokens make up the remaining shortfall as Binance continues buying replacement assets through market and over-the-counter trades.
